COD.note: The document says nothing about a link between the civil register and the ID system.
Digital civil registration is named only as a service the connectivity work will prepare, with no system procured or piloted.

facts.fact: The head of the Access component of the digital transformation project said on 2026-06-19 that the Universal Service Development Fund is to finance mobile broadband sites, 4G and 5G stations and power in rural and peri-urban areas, and that 145 territories are to be connected, with a pilot in seven governorates and 44 administrative offices.

COD.note: The document gives no state budget line, domestic financing statement or spending figure.

facts.fact: ACP reports that the national backbone is under construction within the digital transformation project, as a network of over 11,500 km including 1,500 km of international links to Angola, Uganda, Burundi and the Central African Republic, said by the project's Access component head.

COD.note: The document says nothing about an ID number at birth.
It names digital civil registration only as a future service, with no office entering records digitally.
